statement: The equation $x=\\cos x$ has a root in $[0,1]$. Using the iteration $x_{n+1}=\\cos x_{n}$ with $x_{0}=0.7$, find $x_{1}$ and $x_{2}$ and state the root to four decimal places.
solution: $x_{1}=\\cos0.7\\approx0.7648$. $x_{2}=\\cos0.7648\\approx0.7215$. Continuing, the iteration converges to the root $x\\approx0.7391$.
hints: The values settle to the fixed point.
